changes.evidence: At the end of Kraven the Hunter, after Nikolai's death, Dmitri refuses Sergei's plan to dismantle their father's operation, takes over the business himself, and a year later tells Sergei he has taken over their father's empire (matches the record's step 'he takes over his father's empire as the Chameleon'). The Sony's Spider-Man Universe wiki gives his affiliation (and Nikolai's) as 'Kravinoff Criminal Empire'. New name, from the wiki infobox (no page of its own yet). Before that he only plays piano at his father's club, so the stage starts in this title. Note T:sv-nikolai-kravinoff (other chunk) would share this name.

In 'To Catch a Spider' (the record's episode 19, Marvel Database 1x19A), Dr. Noah Boddy breaks the Green Goblin out of prison along with the other two villains and they form a team to destroy Spider-Man; Spider-Man turns them on each other and all are returned to prison. (Matches the record's 'stops him again after Dr. Noah Boddy frees him'.) Marvel Database's team page 'Spider-Catchers (Earth-6799)' lists Noah Boddy as leader and Green Goblin, Vulture and Electro as former members, status defunct (first and last appearance 1x19A), and the character page's affiliation is Spider-Catchers. New name, named plainly by the wiki team page (the show may only use the episode title 'To Catch a Spider', hence medium). Departure added because the team breaks up in the same episode and he acts alone again.

owner_calls.question: The Big Man (Tombstone) runs New York's main criminal organisation in The Spectacular Spider-Man (Hammerhead as right hand, hires the Enforcers, creates super villains, fights the Master Planner and Silvermane for the city) until his arrest leaves the 'Big Man' position to the Green Goblin. Neither wiki names the organisation. Which group, if any?
options: New name 'Big Man's Organization' for The Spectacular Spider-Man
The Enforcers (he is their employer, not listed as a member)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'His voice was first heard as the Big Man when he had Hammerhead send the Enforcers...'; gang war summit with Master Planner and Silvermane; arrested, makes bail, but his position as Big Man is taken over by the Green Goblin. Enforcers (Earth-26496) page: 'a small team of three career criminals hired by Big Man', leader Montana. Spider-Man wiki infobox: affiliations None.

owner_calls.question: The Foreigner is an assassin hired by Aleksei Sytsevich (Rhino) to kill Kraven; he also kills Rhino's man Bardum for him. The SSU wiki lists his affiliation as 'Rhino's Crew'. Does a hired contract killer count as a member of Rhino's crew?
options: No change (hired assassin, not a member)
Rhino's Crew for Kraven the Hunter (new name, from the SSU wiki)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'The Foreigner was hired by Aleksei Sytsevich to kill Sergei Kravinoff.' SSU wiki: affiliation = Rhino's Crew; works with Rhino throughout the film (kills Bardum, 'a Rhino's employee', on Rhino's call) until Calypso kills him. Note T:sv-rhino-kraven (other chunk) would carry the same crew name.

owner_calls.question: In Spider-Man Unlimited, Venom works for the Synoptic (the symbiote hive mind on Counter-Earth) while posing as a loyal agent of the High Evolutionary and the Knights of Wundagore. Count either as a group?
options: No change (the Synoptic is a single hive-mind being; the Knights role is a cover)
The Knights of Wundagore for Spider-Man Unlimited (double agent)
New name 'The Synoptic' for Spider-Man Unlimited
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database Synoptic page: the Synoptic called Venom and Carnage to Counter-Earth; 'the symbiotes acted as double agents for six months, pretending to work as loyal subordinates of the High Evolutionary and the Knights of Wundagore while they're actually collecting organic beings... for the Synoptic.' Venom's own page has no affiliation listed.
